Tidy Predict

Source: R/predict.R
tv_predict.Rd

Tidier for the varest class.

Usage

tv_predict(x, n.ahead, ...)

# Default S3 method
tv_predict(x, n.ahead, ...)

# S3 method for class 'varest'
tv_predict(x, n.ahead, ...)

Arguments

x

An object of the varest class.

n.ahead

The number of periods ahead in which the prediction should be made.

...

Additional objects to be pass through.

Value

A tibble.

Examples

model <- vars::VAR(EuStockMarkets)
tv_predict(model, n.ahead = 12)
#> # A tibble: 48 × 6
#>    rowid .asset  fcst lower upper    CI
#>    <int> <chr>  <dbl> <dbl> <dbl> <dbl>
#>  1     1 DAX    5478. 5415. 5541.  63.4
#>  2     2 DAX    5482. 5393. 5572.  89.4
#>  3     3 DAX    5486. 5377. 5596. 109. 
#>  4     4 DAX    5490. 5365. 5616. 126. 
#>  5     5 DAX    5494. 5354. 5635. 140. 
#>  6     6 DAX    5498. 5345. 5652. 153. 
#>  7     7 DAX    5502. 5337. 5667. 165. 
#>  8     8 DAX    5506. 5330. 5682. 176. 
#>  9     9 DAX    5510. 5323. 5696. 186.
